hypothesis: A readable natural-language production brief preserves multi-constraint scene fidelity at least as well as semantically equivalent JSON-style structured syntax.
baseline_prompt: Create a polished fantasy-adventure key-art illustration showing an adult courier crossing a rain-darkened rooftop market at blue hour. She carries a folded map tube, wears a layered travel coat over practical boots, and looks toward a distant signal lantern while wind catches the coat hem. Use a three-quarter full-body view, an asymmetric composition, and clear foreground awning edges, midground character action, and background rooflines. The rendering should feel like high-end game promotional art with controlled painterly edges, selective hard highlights, coherent material separation, and a cool environment punctuated by warm lantern light. Keep the focal hierarchy clear and avoid UI, logos, captions, or decorative text.
